# Dilemma v3.1.2

Creating a quiz topic no longer offers `clear_ping`, since a new topic has no saved notification role to remove. Keep `ping_role` in both `/dilemma create` and `/dilemma configure`; keep `clear_ping` only in `/dilemma configure`.

Update the command UX checks and README to match. Re-register Discord commands after deployment so the option disappears from the creation menu. No new database migration is required.
